Method of Attack: Loading a modified boot image to gain root access and elevated privileges on the Peloton Bike+ device
Exploiting a bug that allowed loading modified boot images despite the device being locked
Using the 'su' command to elevate privileges
Potential to remotely activate camera and microphone
Discoverer: McAfee security researchers Sam Quinn and Mark Bereza
Attack Vector: Physical access to the device to load modified boot image
Indicators of Compromise: Modified boot.img loaded via 'fastboot boot' command
Use of 'su' command for root access
